title: HAT-4D: Lifting Monocular Video for 4D Multi-Object Interactions via Human-Agent Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2606.28215v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Extracting dynamic 4D object interactions from massive, in-the-wild monocular videos offers a highly efficient data collection pathway for scaling Embodied AI and training VLAs. However, existing monocular 4D reconstruction methods primarily focus on isolated objects, often failing under the severe occlusions and complex dynamics inherent in multi-object interactions. To bridge this gap, we propose HAT-4D, the first agentic framework designed to reconstruct the 3D geometry, temporal dynamics, and physical interactions of multiple objects from a single video. By integrating VLMs with a multi-level human-in-the-loop feedback mechanism, HAT-4D efficiently resolves depth ambiguities and interaction-induced occlusions during 3D generation and 4D propagation, yielding physically plausible assets without relying on expensive multicamera rigs. translated_title: HAT-4D：通过人-智能体协同将单目视频提升为4D多物体交互
translated_abstract: 从海量的真实场景单目视频中提取动态的4D物体交互，为扩展具身智能和训练视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）提供了一条高效的数据收集途径。然而，现有的单目4D重建方法主要关注孤立物体，在多物体交互中固有的严重遮挡和复杂动态下往往表现不佳。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了HAT-4D，这是首个旨在从单个视频中重建多个物体的3D几何、时间动态和物理交互的智能体框架。通过将视觉语言模型（VLM）与多层次的人在回路反馈机制相结合，HAT-4D在3D生成和4D传播过程中高效地解决了深度歧义和交互引起的遮挡问题，无需依赖昂贵的多相机设备即可生成物理上合理的资产。作为一个可扩展的数据引擎，HAT-4D促进了开放世界基准数据集MVOIK-4D的构建。
tldr: 提出首个基于人-智能体协同的框架HAT-4D，能从单个单目视频中重建多个物体的3D几何、时间动态和物理交互，并据此构建了开放世界基准数据集MVOIK-4D。
en_tdlr: Proposes HAT-4D, the first agentic framework leveraging human-agent collaboration to reconstruct 3D geometry, temporal dynamics, and physical interactions of multiple objects from a single monocular video, enabling the creation of the open-world benchmark MVOIK-4D.
